posts.en:
dsh-sub2api is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-813b5048fc0945987c9e.html
